newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NASPERS CHIEF SLAMS S.AFRICAN PROVINCES ON PAYMENT.
newsitem.headline: NASPERS CHIEF SLAMS S.AFRICAN PROVINCES ON PAYMENT.

text.p: The refusal of some provincial education departments to pay their debts on time should be referred to the Auditor-General, Nasionale Pers Ltd chairman Ton Vosloo said on Friday.
"Sometimes there are excessively long delays on payment of delivered orders," Vosloo told the printing and publishing group's annual general meeting.
"In fact, the authorities want a say in the price determination of titles and then claim free credit by non-payment."
He said it boded ill when the state and its institutions eroded the profit margins of suppliers who paid their taxes.
"In our opinion, the matter should be referred to the scrutiny of the Auditor-General's office," he said.
Weak orders and late payments have dogged the group's Nasboek division over the last few years but it has formed alliances with several black-owned operations that should help it in the year ahead.
